text:
Alex Chang: Heads-up — planning config cutover for gpu-pool-7 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. We'll apply new autoscale policy (autoscale-v2) and a KV-cache eviction tweak. Need: deploy lead, smoke checklist, rollback owner, and a quick canary step. Ping if you can join. @Maya @Liam
Maya Patel: I can take lead on deploy window. 02:00 UTC works for me. Will coordinate canary in eu-west-1 first. I'll run the smoke checks and monitor latency.
Liam Johnson: I'll be on standby for rollback and logs. Can you post the exact CLI and smoke commands?
Alex Chang: thx. smoke commands below — run from infractl box:
```bash
rwd infra apply --pool gpu-pool-7 --file /srv/deploys/gpu-pool-7/autoscale-v2.yaml --dry-run=false
rwd infra smoke --pool gpu-pool-7 --check latency,kv-hitrate --timeout 5m
```
Zara Chen: infra PR #4123 merged, image pinned to rwd/gpu-runtime:1.8.0. Note: temp disable burst for the canary slice. Added metrics dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/in/gpu-pool-7
ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled by Maya Patel for 2134567890 -> 2134571400, reminder set 30m before.
Samira Noor: I'll notify CS and include rollback playbook. Add a Slack thread for oncall paging if smoke fails: #eng-oncall.
Liam Johnson: Quick rollback plan: run `rwd infra rollback --pool gpu-pool-7 --to-image rwd/gpu-runtime:1.7.3` and revert autoscale config. Need approver: Alex or Maya.
Maya Patel: I'll trigger canary at T+10m, validate p95 < 250ms and kv-hitrate > 95%. If fail, rollback immediately. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chang: OK I'm approver for rollback. Maya you got the runbook? I'll be available to cut a revert patch.
Maya Patel: got it. I'll post status updates during the window. tagging @Liam @Zara for logs and infra alerts.
Alex Chang: Thanks everyone — see you at 01:50 UTC for preflight checks. :rocket:
